federation.note: M1 of the maintainer's personal agent (agentic-solid-vision/docs/NOW-PERSONAL-AGENT.md): the works-today counterpart of the Accountable Web of Agents vision paper. Composes the suite's hardened packages under a hard Reader / pod / Actor / outbox trust split (section 2 + section 7) so NO single context both reads hostile input and holds act-credentials. (a) The READER: a thin Gmail ChannelAdapter (users.messages.list+get?format=raw via an injectable gmail.readonly token seam + SSRF-guarded fetch, redirect-refusing) feeds the LANDED @jeswr/agentic-legacy-bridge pipeline (hardened parseEmail -> owner-private ACL-first importInbound + the deterministic-first section 5 metadata interpreter: composeInterpreters(structuredMetadata, deterministic, optional-LLM)); no bespoke RFC/RDF parsing. (b) POD-AS-STATE: owner-private inbox/proposals/outbox containers, fail-closed owner-only WAC ACL written BEFORE any content (bridge buildOwnerOnlyAclTurtle), regression-tested. (c) The ACTOR skeleton on the Claude Agent SDK (section 3.3): deterministic section 5 path FIRST (reads landed structured-metadata Interpretations with zero LLM tokens), LLM only for residual prose via the bridge Interpreter seam; reads the pod through @jeswr/solid-mcp read-only tools; a fail-closed canUseTool gate (allow pod reads + proposal-container writes ONLY; deny Bash/Write/Edit/WebFetch/everything else); the Actor only PROPOSES (writes an agentic:ActionProposal record) and holds NO send tokens. (d) The OUTBOX EXECUTOR: deterministic, no-LLM, consumes ONLY human-confirmed proposals, builds the section 5.2 signed carrier (bridge buildReply/buildActionMetadata + injectable solid-vc signer seam), sends via an injectable per-channel ChannelSender seam that alone holds send-scope tokens, and writes a PROV receipt. Every credential is a seam (Gmail OAuth token, pod authed fetch, channel send tokens, the billed Anthropic API key) — M1 builds to the seams and stops there; no live credentials required to build/test. Untrusted-email surface exhaustively hostile-input tested (over-cap/redirect/non-2xx/header-injection/HTML-body/script-in-JSON-LD/path-traversal message-ids) by composing the bridge's hardened parsers, never re-opening a hole. One minted namespace only (https://w3id.org/jeswr/agentic#) reusing the bridge's vocab for the proposal record; everything else reuses schema.org/PROV/dct. ignore-scripts=true; committed dist (GitHub-installable; @jeswr git deps ship their own committed dist). npm publish deferred (needs:user). needs:user for go-live: Gmail OAuth app + gmail.readonly token, a billed Anthropic API key, per-channel send tokens, an always-on host.
